title: Collapsible
description: An interactive component which expands/collapses a panel.
summary: Interactive component for expanding and collapsing content panels.
shortDescription: The Collapsible component provides a simple expand/collapse mechanism for showing and hiding content. Unlike Accordion which manages multiple collapsible sections with mutual exclusivity, Collapsible is a single standalone component ideal for progressive disclosure patterns. Common use cases include showing additional details, revealing form sections, or hiding secondary content until needed. Typically composed of a trigger element and a content panel with smooth animated transitions.
